---
title: "Pittsburgh Weather PCA"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(openmeteo)
library(arrow)
library(paletteer)
library(ggrepel)

options(scipen = 999, digits = 4)

theme_set(theme_bw())
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

location <- "Pittsburgh, PA"

weather_data <- weather_history(
  location = location,
  start = "1980-01-01",
  end = "2026-09-10",
  daily = weather_variables()$daily_history_vars
) |>
  mutate(location = location, .before = 1)

write_parquet(
  weather_data,
  "posts/pittsburgh_weather_pca/post_data/weather_data.parquet"
)
```

```{r}
weather_data <- read_parquet(
  "posts/pittsburgh_weather_pca/post_data/weather_data.parquet"
)
```

```{r}
glimpse(weather_data)

weather_data$daily_weather_code |> summary()
```

```{r}
drop_bad_cols <- function(x) {
  bad_cols <- x |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = everything(),
      names_to = "column_name",
      values_to = "value"
    ) |>
    summarize(is_constant = n_distinct(value) == 1, .by = column_name) |>
    filter(is_constant == TRUE) |>
    distinct(column_name) |>
    pull(column_name)

  print(str_c("dropping ", str_c(bad_cols, collapse = ", ")))

  x <- select(x, -all_of(bad_cols))
}
```

```{r}
pca_fit <- weather_data |>
  select(where(is.numeric)) |>
  select(-daily_weather_code) |>
  drop_bad_cols() |>
  prcomp(scale = TRUE)
```

```{r}
weather_data_pca <- pca_fit |>
  augment(weather_data) |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "^.fittedPC", "pc_"))

pca_fit |>
  tidy(matrix = "eigenvalues") |>
  ggplot(aes(PC, percent)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:9) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))
  )
```

```{r}
weather_data_pca |>
  mutate(month = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(pc_1, pc_2, color = month)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = .1) +
  scale_color_paletteer_d("jcolors::pal12") +
  coord_fixed()

weather_data_pca |>
  mutate(month = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(pc_1, pc_3, color = month)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = .1) +
  scale_color_paletteer_d("jcolors::pal12") +
  coord_fixed()
```

```{r}
# define arrow style for plotting
arrow_style <- arrow(
  angle = 20,
  ends = "first",
  type = "closed",
  length = grid::unit(8, "pt")
)

pca_fit |>
  tidy(matrix = "rotation") |>
  group_by(PC) |>
  slice_max(abs(value), n = 5) |>
  filter(PC %in% c(1:5)) |>
  view()

# plot rotation matrix
pca_rot <- pca_fit |>
  tidy(matrix = "rotation") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "PC", names_prefix = "PC", values_from = "value")

pca_rot |>
  #mutate(text = str_wrap(column, width = 0)) |>
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_segment(xend = 0, yend = 0, arrow = arrow_style) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = column)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = .2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = .2))
```

```{r}
weather_data_pca_time <- weather_data_pca |>
  select(date, starts_with("pc_")) |>
  mutate(
    decade = year(date) %/% 10,
    decade = str_c(decade, "0's"),
    year = year(date),
    yday = yday(date)
  )

weather_data_pca_time |>
  select(date, decade, pc_1:pc_5) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("pc_")) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, color = name)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(vars(decade), ncol = 1, scales = "free_x")
```


```{r}
weather_data_pca_time |>
  select(yday, year, pc_1:pc_5) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("pc_")) |>
  ggplot(aes(yday, value)) +
  #geom_point(aes(color = year), alpha = .01) +
  geom_smooth(color = "black") +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  facet_wrap(vars(name), ncol = 1, scales = "free_y")
```
